description:
Finish the fixture-model migration by deleting residue no current harness
consumes. Retain only metadata and sidecars expressing an ENFORCED behavioral,
diagnostic, rendering, allocation, or compiler-shape contract.

## Verified residue at main 417c5b0b5

- 50 fixtures carry 500 `budget.*` frontmatter lines
  (`grep -rl "^# budget\." fixtures2/ | wc -l` -> 50; `grep -rh` -> 500) from the
  deleted dump-stats workflow.
- `FixtureMetadata` still PARSES them but nothing evaluates them:
  `BudgetAssertion` (src/compiler2/fixture_metadata.rs:75), field
  `budget_assertions` (:57), parser arm `_ if key.starts_with("budget.")` (:273),
  export at src/compiler2/mod.rs:75, test construction at
  fixture_metadata_test.rs:54. `grep -n "budget" tests/fixture_matrix.rs` returns
  NOTHING.
- The producing workflow is gone: `fz2 dump --help` -> `unknown command 'dump'`;
  no `dump_budgets` test and no `DUMP_BUDGET_TOLERANCE_PERCENT` anywhere.
- `participates_in_matrix` (fixture_metadata.rs:30) has no caller outside
  fixture_metadata_test.rs:98/:118; directory membership owns participation
  (`behavior_dir`, fixture_matrix.rs:551). Its body ORs in
  `!budget_assertions.is_empty()` (:37), so the two deletions are COUPLED.
- `fixtures2/GOLDEN.md` still documents FOUR paths (:9, :63) and the whole budget
  workflow (:32, :143-146, :163-180). The matrix runs THREE:
  `FixtureMatrixPath::{Run, Interp, Build}` (fixture_matrix.rs:220-222).
- `.agent/docs/fixtures.md` CONTRADICTS ITSELF: :200 says the dump-budget trial
  is gone; :50, :210 and :220 still list `budget.<namespace>.<metric>` as live
  metadata.
- `fixtures2/behavior/vr5a_cross_kind_eq.expected.jit.diagnostics` and
  `.expected.aot.diagnostics` are orphans; the matrix resolves
  `expected.{run,interp,build}.diagnostics` and never reads jit/aot.

## Work

Delete all `budget.*` frontmatter, `BudgetAssertion`, `budget_assertions`, the
parser arm, the export and its tests. Delete `participates_in_matrix` once the
budget term is removed and the caller audit is still empty. Remove the two orphan
sidecars. Rewrite `fixtures2/GOLDEN.md` and reconcile `.agent/docs/fixtures.md`
around the current three-path model and telemetry-backed `assert.metric.*`
compiler contracts. Make `budget.*` an UNKNOWN key so stale decoration fails
loudly.

Do not translate obsolete planner/codegen counts into new metrics without first
proving a current invariant. Do not retain dead compatibility vocabulary.

## Checks

Repository search finds no `budget.*` frontmatter, `BudgetAssertion`,
dump-budget workflow, four-path matrix claim, `.expected.jit.diagnostics` or
`.expected.aot.diagnostics`. Behavioral discovery and compiler-contract parsing
tests pass; full lib + matrix + strict clippy.

Note: this ticket was verified line-for-line accurate as filed. Nothing in it was
stale -- unusual for this backlog, and worth knowing when reading it.
title: Delete residual legacy fixture metadata, APIs, documentation, and sidecars
